source: Full500 actual solver child receipts, no new evaluation

policy.acceptance: M3 strict, M2 nonworse, G nonworse

memory.note: Frontier equals hypothetical no-spill Step2 peak under singleton/source guards. It is NOT a runtime Step3 peak or a no-memory-edge certificate.

compute_MV_FIFO.interpretation: Original compute plus M/V FIFO fixed-plan lower bound; omits COPY service, bandwidth, cache and memory edges.

whole_word_envelope.interpretation: Conservative envelope for complete-path remote COUNT, including possible COPY FIFO and memory edges; L values are NOT official bounds.

traffic_prediction.note: Source-rule counts only; no measured traffic, hit rate or cycle value.
